ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 4, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (21) Omitted.

(22) Part of the Rules on Emeritus Professors shall be amended as follows:

In Article 6 (2), "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology".

(23) through (63) Omitted.
